Overview

Klaipėda is a city in Klaipėda County with a population of 147,892. Lithuania’s major port city on the Baltic Sea, with a charming German-influenced old town, the nearby Curonian Spit, and a bustling maritime atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
